name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt the 3px focus ring at 6:1 contrast. It meets WCAG AA for low vision and works on mobile/touch without shrinking the ring so small it disappears. The trade-off is slightly less crisp focus on high-DPI screens, but that’s rare and WCAG still passes.

name: Reader
text: A 3px ring at 6:1 fails AAA for low vision and risks excluding users who need stronger contrast. Test a 4px ring at 7:1 instead—WCAG AAA passes, and on high-DPI screens, the ring remains visible because the pixel collapse is less severe than at 3px. Run user tests with screen-reader users who need high contrast to settle it.
